verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of how TeamViewer reaches a machine away from home, whether by relay/broker servers, VPN mode, or port forwarding. The docs only make generic marketing claims such as "Fix issues remotely". The one community mention of a home VPN (teamviewer-comm-3) describes the user's own setup, which is a workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can reach my machine away from home, with the relay, VPN, or port-forward path documented
